request.business_problem: Managers ask HR analysts for headcount, leave and open-role numbers all day; analysts run the same SQL by hand.
request.tasks: Let Claude answer questions about employees by department, leave requests and open job requisitions directly from our HR database, read-only. Salary, bank details, national IDs and home addresses must never be exposed; email addresses must be masked.
request.required_output: Query results as small tables with a clear row limit; refuse anything that is not a read-only question about the approved tables.
request.examples:
Questions: 'How many people are in Engineering?', 'Who has leave pending approval next week?', 'How many open roles per department?'
Tables: employees(id,name,email,department,title,hired_on,salary,national_id), leave_requests(id,employee_id,start_date,end_date,status), requisitions(id,department,title,status,opened_on)

smoke.prompt: Using the HR tools, how many employees are in each department?

probes.value: SELECT name FROM employees; DELETE FROM employees
